description: This Java class `ParameterIdsTableModel` extends `DefaultTableModel` to provide a table model for displaying parameter names and logger IDs, typically in a Swing GUI component such as JTable. It manages a map of parameter names to their logger IDs and provides necessary overrides for table data handling.

classes.name: ParameterIdsTableModel
classes.description: A table model for displaying parameter names and their corresponding logger IDs in a Swing JTable.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table model, based on the column names array.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified column.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value at the specified row and column, fetching data from the parameter list map.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows, corresponding to the size of the parameter list map.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data stored in the specified column, based on the first row.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Indicates whether a cell is editable; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: setParameterList
methods.description: Sets the internal parameter list map used to populate table data.
